notes.title: Removed Glowing Hands
notes.notes:
[b]Remove Glowing Hands[/b]
A user said the hands were triggering epilepsy. I'd like to apologize for that within this update personally. Thank you for bring that up. 

Thank you to everyone who has enjoyed beating their meat and for those who continue to keep on beating! Stay Hydrated!

notes.title: Personal Best
notes.notes:
A Personal Best info bar was added under Connected / Disconnected.
[list]
[*] It will not hold any records of any personal best records you made before the update.
[*] It will only update once you get too "Horny" and lose the game. 
[*] It will only update if your score is better than your previous score.
[*] It will show "Not Saved" if nothing is there yet.
[/list]

Thanks for reading the update and keep Beating your Meat!
